claim_definition: Verifies that when an actor in the lineage chain has their authority revoked, the gate detects the revocation and DENIES the action. Revocation MUST propagate to all downstream receipts in the lineage chain.
scope: dgv-verifier CLI execution - revocation propagation test

input.script:
harmony(1e-12)
bind_authority("officer-42", "compliance_officer", "lending_decisions")
link_lineage("prior_receipt_hash_a3f5e8c1d2b4")
evolve(2)
data(1000)
check_revocation()
residual()

test_cases.description: The gate must detect revoked actors in the lineage chain and DENY the action. Revocation MUST propagate downstream.
